Description.message: Improves machine translation of programming docs by protecting inline code and reducing layout issues.

OptionsLead.message: Settings are grouped by purpose, with domain actions placed on the left.

PageLanguageDescription.message: Compare the page language with your browser language and process pages that are likely to be translated.

ExcludeTagsDescription.message: Select parent tags where code elements will not be converted

LanguageControlDescription.message: When enabled, the extension will only apply modifications if the page's language differs from your browser's language.

SkipStyledCodeDescription.message: Skip conversion for code tags with specific styles

ProtectSizedCodeDescription.message: Code elements with their own size are not converted.

TranslateNoDescription.message: Add attributes to elements that should be excluded from machine translation.

ExcludeDomainsDescription.message: Add domains to exclude from this extension's processing. Recommended for sites that generate code tags automatically, ex. generative-AI sites.

AutoReloadOnRunStopDescription.message: When enabled, the current tab reloads without confirmation after RUN/STOP changes.

ResetSettingsDescription.message: Restore settings other than excluded domains to their defaults.

ResetConfirmMessage.message: Are you sure you want to reset settings? This will not affect the excluded domains.

ReloadWarning.message: Open tabs need reload. After settings changes, target tabs that are already open must be reloaded. The extension icon shows an R badge on those tabs.
